findings.problem: The hint only rules out claro, but other two-word phrases also mean of course, such as cómo no (very common in Latin America) and desde luego.
findings.fix: hint: two-word phrase starting with por, not claro

back.example: Will you help me? Of course.

note: Using a fixed two-word phrase as a content card for supuesto makes sense, because por supuesto is by far the word's most frequent use in subtitles.
